description: Bestway Cement Limited is a Pakistani cement producer and, in its group's words, the country's largest cement manufacturer. It operates five plants — Hattar and Farooqia in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, and Chakwal, Kallar Kahar and Mianwali in Punjab — producing ordinary Portland and special-purpose cements under brands including Bestway, Pakcem, Stallion, Ecocem and Duracem, alongside tile adhesives and grouts. The company is part of the Bestway Group.
headOffice: Bestway Building, 19-A, College Road, F-7 Markaz, Islamabad 44000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: bestway.com.pk — home page, Board of Directors (chief executive listing), Contact Information, Plant Sites, Domestic Products and Cement Production pages (accessed 2026-10-17)

products.name: BESTWAY All Purpose Cement
products.summary: Ordinary Portland cement for general construction — pavements, bridges, buildings, floor slabs, culverts and precast blocks; complies with PS 232:2008 (R) 53 Grade and EN 197-1 CEM I 42,5 N.

products.name: PAKCEM
products.summary: All-purpose cement that the company says was the first product in Pakistan to deliver up to 10,000 PSI strength.

products.name: STALLION
products.summary: Early-setting cement for the precast segment, formulated so formwork can be released sooner while keeping a high-quality finish.

products.name: ECOCEM
products.summary: Economy cement for price-conscious construction, positioned by the company as a balance between cost and strength (EN 197-1 CEM II/B-M 42,5 N).

products.name: DURACEM
products.summary: General-purpose ordinary Portland cement to ASTM C150 Type I, for pavements, bridges, buildings and precast products.

products.name: XTREME Tile Bond
products.summary: Floor and wall tile adhesive, described by the company as anti-sagging with 9–10 hours of open time and no curing required.
